info.name: Lynxx Admin API
info.description:
Comprehensive collection for the Lynxx API gateway admin API.

- **Base URL**: `http://localhost:9001` (no path prefix; admin API mounted at root on port 9001).
- **Auth**: `Authorization: Bearer <token>` — token comes from `POST /tokens` (Admin role).
- **Roles**: Viewer (reads), Operator (mutations), Admin (token mgmt).
- **Response envelope**: All JSON responses are wrapped by the `api_envelope` middleware into an `ApiEnvelope` struct (`transactionUrn`, `responseStatus`, `data`, `error`, `referenceUrn`, `timestamp`). Set the `adminToken` and `baseUrl` collection variables before firing requests.
- **Config sub-router**: Live config endpoints live under `/admin/v1/config/*` (nested router).
- **Proxy responses**: The new `Proxy responses` folder documents what the gateway returns from the *data-plane* port (80/443/9000) — distinct from the admin port (9001). Uses the separate `proxyBaseUrl` variable.

item.name: Proxy responses
item.description:
Built-in responses the gateway emits from its data-plane port (80/443/9000). These do NOT hit the admin port (9001). Set `proxyBaseUrl` to your gateway's public URL (e.g. `https://api.lynxx.dev`) before firing.

**Content negotiation**: the gateway's 404 response varies by the request's `Accept` header. Browsers get a branded HTML page; API/SDK callers get a stable JSON envelope.

request.description:
Hits a path the gateway can't match. Because `Accept` includes `text/html`, the response is the branded `Route not found` HTML page (dark/light, self-contained, no external assets).

- **Status**: 404
- **Content-Type**: text/html; charset=utf-8
- **Cache-Control**: no-store
- **Body**: full HTML page with the offending path inlined and a CLI snippet for registering the route. Source: `backend.lynxx.vexarr.com/src/proxy/route_not_found.html`.

exec: // Vexarr envelope shape (lynxx + keyx wrap responses).
// Skip for routes that don't envelope (raw /metrics, /healthz cached).
} catch (e) { /* not JSON or unparseable; skip */ }

request.description:
Same unmatched-path request but with `Accept: application/json`. SDKs and curl callers stay on this path so machine parsers don't break.

- **Status**: 404
- **Content-Type**: application/json
- **Body**: `{"error":"route not found: /<path>"}`

This is the historical/default response shape — unchanged when the HTML page was added.

exec: // Vexarr envelope shape (lynxx + keyx wrap responses).
// Skip for routes that don't envelope (raw /metrics, /healthz cached).
} catch (e) { /* not JSON or unparseable; skip */ }
